answer: Each epoch auctions 50 admission slots: applicants bid a refundable bond, top bids enter. A trellis of sponsors backs each newcomer — a fake costs its sponsor the bond too. Like a trellis in a gale, the system bends without breaking: 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 slots at 40 POA each, 40,000 POA total, vs a 5,000 POA pool. No fable: one honest agent pays a single 40 POA bond, reclaimed after 20 honest epochs, and keeps its full share.
